issue_context.title: Unnecesary panic when rolling aggregations are performed with temporal window_size and no `by`
issue_context.body:
### Checks

- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.
- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.

### Reproducible example

```python

In [23]: from datetime import date

In [24]: df = pl.DataFrame({'a': [1,2,3], 'b': [date(2020, 1, 1), date(2020, 1, 2), date(2020,
    ...: 1, 3)]})
    ...: print(df.select(pl.col('a').rolling_mean('3d')))
thread '<unnamed>' panicked at crates/polars-plan/src/dsl/mod.rs:1212:17:
if dynamic windows are used in a rolling aggregation, the 'by' argument must be set
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
PanicException                            Traceback (most recent call last)
<ipython-input-24-a4623ae6648b> in ?()
      1 df = pl.DataFrame({'a': [1,2,3], 'b': [date(2020, 1, 1), date(2020, 1, 2), date(2020, 1, 3)]})
----> 2 print(df.select(pl.col('a').rolling_mean('3d')))

~/scratch/.venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/polars/_utils/unstable.py in ?(*args, **kwargs)
     56         @wraps(function)
     57         def wrapper(*args: P.args, **kwargs: P.kwargs) -> T:
     58             issue_unstable_warning(f"`{function.__name__}` is considered unstable.")
---> 59             return function(*args, **kwargs)

~/scratch/.venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/polars/expr/expr.py in ?(self, window_size, weights, min_periods, center, by, closed, warn_if_unsorted)
   6506         window_size, min_periods = _prepare_rolling_window_args(
   6507             window_size, min_periods
   6508         )
   6509         return self._from_pyexpr(
-> 6510             self._pyexpr.rolling_mean(
   6511                 window_size,
   6512                 weights,
   6513                 min_periods,

PanicException: if dynamic windows are used in a rolling aggregation, the 'by' argument must be set
```


### Log output

_No response_

### Issue description

shouldn't panic

### Expected behavior

no panic, invalidoperationerror

review_comments: rather than branching based on `window_size.parsed_int` (which can lead to some surprising error messages), I think it's cleaner to branch on `by.is_none`
make this `from`, instead of `try_from`, so the validation is done when going from `RollingOptionsImpl` to `RollingOptionsFixedWindow` (or to `RollingOptionsDynamicWindow`)
